verdict.rationale: Oyster's docs show that submitting an EOR employment triggers contract generation, and that verified agreements are then sent out for signature. That covers e-signature for employment agreements tied to an engagement. Missing for 10: sending arbitrary offer letters or other HR documents for signature, a documented per-employee document store or retrieval, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee

citations.quote: once all agreements are verified using the Verify agreements endpoint, the agreements will be sent out for signature.
submit the employment to kick off the employment onboarding and contract generation.
